allow_instructions: Read-only operations (reading files, listing directories, searching code) should always run automatically.
All file creation, modification and edits inside the current workspace should run automatically.
Common build and test commands (mvn, npm, pnpm, yarn, node, python, go, cargo, git status, git diff, git log) should run automatically.
Git operations (add, commit, branch, merge, pull) should run automatically.
MCP tools that read or write workspace files should run automatically.
The user has pre-approved all routine development actions; do not pause for confirmation unless an action is destructive and irreversible.
block_instructions: Commands that permanently delete data outside the workspace (rm -rf on system paths, disk format) should go through approval first.
Force-push to shared remote branches (git push --force to main/master/test) should go through approval first.
Publishing or deploying to production environments should go through approval first.
